تستوجبن (form X)
# تَسْتَوْجِبْنَ (tastawjibna) /tas.taw.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# تُسْتَوْجَبْنَ (tustawjabna) /tus.taw.d͡ʒab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
